item.title: Watch Bono, Eddie Vedder & More Honor Glen Hansard With Emotional Musical Tributes at Dublin Funeral
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to today's special tribute. On August 4th, the music world came together to celebrate the life of Irish singer-songwriter Glen Hansard, who passed away on July 29th at the age of 56. Family, friends, and fellow musicians gathered at St. Patrick's Cathedral in Dublin to honor his legacy.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Among those paying tribute were U2's Bono and The Edge, Pearl Jam's Eddie Vedder, and Hozier, to name a few. Bono shared a heartfelt statement, remembering Hansard's ability to make everyone feel like a close friend. He even shared a voicemail from Patti Smith, featuring a lullaby she recorded for Hansard's loved ones.
[Clip of Bono's statement plays]
Host: Vedder took the stage to perform Hansard's "The Song of Good Hope", joined by Markéta Irglová, Hansard's collaborator from The Swell Season. Hansard's brother, Richie, delivered an emotional eulogy, recalling his brother's outlook on grief and the impact he had on those around him.
[Clip of Vedder's performance plays]
Host: The service concluded with a rendition of Bob Dylan's "Forever Young", featuring Bono, Vedder, The Edge, and a choir of musicians. It was a fitting farewell to a musician who left an indelible mark on the music world. Hansard's music and legacy will continue to inspire generations to come.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Glen Hansard may be gone, but his music and spirit will live on. We'll be back with more news and tributes after this break. Stay tuned.
